critique: The artwork achieves a striking cyber-nature fusion by seamlessly blending the slow, breathing animation of the central masked portrait with beautifully undulating, procedurally generated sand dunes that dynamically accumulate falling grains. However, the semi-transparent guinea pig asset in the corner feels like a visually disconnected afterthought; passing it through the same multiply blend modes or allowing the falling particles to physically collide with its silhouette would better integrate it into this surreal ecosystem.
